name: @equin/plugin-ui-theme-engine-token-var-name
description: The CSS custom property a token-group schema key paints (tokenVarName: `--` + its kebab case). A leaf with no imports, so the static token-group reader (token-usage, run by the cross-refs facet) spells vars exactly as defineTokenGroup does without loading the theme engine — that facet's record key follows this module, not the theme-engine barrel.
